summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a binding proposal and Share Purchase Agreement to acquire COPEL's 23.03% equity stake in Dona Francisca Energética S.A. (DFESA) for an enterprise value of R$150 million, payable in cash at closing. The deal, together with a previously announced acquisition from CELESC, will give Gerdau 100% of DFESA for a total R$300 million enterprise value, adding 30.4 average MW of self-generation capacity. Closing is subject to antitrust approval in Brazil. The board recommends the transaction, aligned with Gerdau's decarbonization strategy. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and integration risk.
